response.sql: SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.amount >= 2400 AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Rows with types other than PRIJEM/VYDAJ (e.g. VYBER, NULL) are excluded entirely, so they affect neither the signed average nor the average balance ('those transactions' means the ones counted).
The amount >= 2400 filter is applied to the unsigned stored amount.
Ties in average balance are broken arbitrarily.

alternatives.interpretation: Average balance is computed over all transactions with amount >= 2400 (including VYBER/other/missing types), while the signed average still only uses PRIJEM/VYDAJ rows.
